$$

$$
\{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}=-11 \\ 4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}=8 \\ 2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}=-14\end{aligned}
$$

Adding the second and the third equations we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}6{x}_{1} & =-6 \\ {x}_{1} & =-1,\end{aligned}
$$

which we substitute into the second equation to get 

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} & =8 \\ 4(-1)+3{x}_{2} & =8 \\ 3{x}_{2} & =12 \\ {x}_{2} & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=-1$ and ${x}_{2}=4$ into the first equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} & =-11 \\ 3(-1)-2(4) & =-11 \\ -11 & =-11,\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement. 

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-1$ and ${x}_{2}=4,$ which means

$$
-{a}_{1}+4{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=-1+4=3.
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["answer-field-50ab6af3-7838-5baf-b926-7d20ec2e1151"] :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id "answer-field-50ab6af3-7838-5baf-b926-7d20ec2e1151" :answer-field/id #uuid "50ab6af3-7838-5baf-b926-7d20ec2e1151" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/correct "answer-9a314fbe-bce0-5c72-becd-d86fdd89cb4c" :answer-field/choices ["answer-877b327c-7099-5b51-a1a0-e54f12c801d5" "answer-b6573507-37c6-5328-ab6e-7644606e55a7" "answer-0fdd8247-3e99-5680-9837-f81ce2e4daa8" "answer-9a314fbe-bce0-5c72-becd-d86fdd89cb4c" "answer-6588aecf-5be8-5075-92ab-05e2c0bd205f"] :db/ensure [:answer-field/validate]} {:db/id "answer-877b327c-7099-5b51-a1a0-e54f12c801d5" :answer/id #uuid "877b327c-7099-5b51-a1a0-e54f12c801d5" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-3" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-b6573507-37c6-5328-ab6e-7644606e55a7" :answer/id #uuid "b6573507-37c6-5328-ab6e-7644606e55a7" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-4" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-0fdd8247-3e99-5680-9837-f81ce2e4daa8" :answer/id #uuid "0fdd8247-3e99-5680-9837-f81ce2e4daa8" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "2" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-9a314fbe-bce0-5c72-becd-d86fdd89cb4c" :answer/id #uuid "9a314fbe-bce0-5c72-becd-d86fdd89cb4c" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id "answer-6588aecf-5be8-5075-92ab-05e2c0bd205f" :answer/id #uuid "6588aecf-5be8-5075-92ab-05e2c0bd205f" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "No solution" :db/ensure [:answer/validate]} {:db/id 17592186342130 :question/worked-solution "If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then   we have

However, the final equation $0=-12$  gives a false statement. So the system has no solution." :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id 17592186342133 :question/worked-solution "If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have
